commands.command:
set -u
HOST="192.168.0.100"
PORT="36451"

echo "=== LOCAL WIFI/IP ==="
networksetup -getinfo Wi-Fi 2>/dev/null || true
echo "wifi_ip=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || true)"

echo "=== ROUTE ==="
route -n get "$HOST" 2>&1 || true

echo "=== ARP ==="
arp -n "$HOST" 2>&1 || true

echo "=== PING ==="
ping -c 3 -W 1000 "$HOST" 2>&1 || true

echo "=== TCP PORT ==="
nc -vz -w 3 "$HOST" "$PORT" 2>&1 || true

echo "=== HOSTNAME ==="
dscacheutil -q host -a name Android-2.local 2>&1 || true

echo "=== ADB MDNS ==="
adb start-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
adb mdns services 2>&1 || true

echo "=== ADB DIRECT ==="
adb connect "$HOST:$PORT" 2>&1 || true
adb devices -l 2>&1 || true
